newsitem.title: USA: Goldman taps S&P's Welch for credit group.
newsitem.headline: Goldman taps S&P's Welch for credit group.

text.p: Patrick Welch, formerly a director of the structured finance ratings group at Standard & Poor's, has joined the credit department at Goldman, Sachs & Co Inc, market sources said.
Welch will be a vice president at Goldman, focusing on evaluating risk on asset-backed commercial paper offerings. Welch previously ran S&P's credit card-backed securities ratings group.
The credit department at Goldman is headed by Barry Zubrow.
Prior to his seven-year tenure with S&P's structured finance ratings group, Welch was a mortgage-backed securities analyst at Security Pacific National Bank, which was acquired by BankAmerica Corp.
